submitted.body:
An explicit Euler tour of the full clustered overlap graph O(4) visits all 24 permutation edges, but nine of its windows force a strict comparison cycle. No cyclic word over any linearly ordered alphabet can realize that tour. This refutes the assertion that every such Euler tour is realizable; it does not deny the existence of universal cycles. The comparison-digraph method is classical; the contribution is this obstruction for the full permutation graph.

**Result and scope:** Hurlbert's ordering conjecture (Kirsch-Sibley-Sprangel Conjecture 6.3; Hurlbert 1990; the Chung-Diaconis-Graham 1992 belief) is false at n = 4: an explicit Euler tour of the clustered overlap graph O(4) is realized by no cyclic word over any linearly ordered alphabet

**Complete proof and verification sources:** [An Euler tour of the full permutation overlap graph that no cyclic word realizes: a refutation of Hurlbert's ordering conjecture for universal cycles of permutations](https://mathdb.com/abs/2611.00057) · [PDF](https://mathdb.com/pdf/2611.00057v1).

The paper page includes the supplementary proof-source JSON attachment and `extract_sources.py`, which reconstruct the archived proof and verification sources. The linked paper gives the complete rigorous argument and specifies exactly which statements are formalized.
